title: EMBrACe – Patient empowerment through competence: reaching for health beyond the absence of cancer.
summary:
EMBrACe is a study that we have been preparing in the German Hodgkin Study Group (GHSG) with the support of the Deutsche Krebshilfe (German Cancer Aid) since May 2022.
It is a randomized study in which we want to include a total of around 300 patients with a first diagnosis of Hodgkin lymphoma (HL) from around 20 different centers in Germany. The aim of the study is to improve the extent to which HL patients are informed by providing them with independent, evidence-based, patient-oriented information via an interactive internet platform (EMBrACe platform). Then, using standardized, validated questionnaires, it should be checked whether the level of information is higher as compared to the control group and, as a secondary question, whether this ultimately leads to a better quality of life. Other secondary study endpoints are the level of health literacy, the individual need for information and satisfaction at different points in time, as well as the use of disease-specific health services, progression-free survival and overall survival. The information is intended to empower patients to regain their autonomy, participate in decisions and actively shape their lives after cancer. The EMBrACe platform is intended to accompany patients during and after Hodgkin's lymphoma and to strengthen their equal role within the healthcare system.
In summary, the EMBrACe study is a patient-oriented study and a new approach together with our Hodgkin patients. If the EMBrACe study shows a positive effect, then the platform will be made available to all HL patients in the future, but also to medical staff, relatives and anyone interested in HL.

interventions.name: Arm A (control group): Limited access to the EMBrACe platform, including links to the GSHG homepage and other pre-existing websites, from HL initial diagnosis up to one year after first-line therapy.
Arm B (intervention group): Full access to the EMBrACe platform from HL initial diagnosis up to one year after first-line therapy

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Histologically verified initial diagnosis of Hodgkin lymphoma
The patient is therapy-naïve with regard to HL
Written declaration of consent to participate in the study available
The patient agrees that the personal data will be made available to the study in compliance with data protection.
Exclusion criteria:
• Inability to communicate in German
• lack of compliance
